title: Luchi
description: Puffed, pale golden Bengali deep fried maida flatbreads, traditionally served with aloor dom or cholar dal for a weekend breakfast.
steps: Mix the maida with the salt and sugar, then rub in the ghee until the flour looks like breadcrumbs.
Add about 120 ml of water gradually and knead to a firm, smooth dough; cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Divide into 12 small balls and roll each into a thin 4 inch round, dusting lightly with flour.
Heat the oil to medium-high and test with a pinch of dough, which should rise at once.
Slide in one luchi at a time and press it down with the back of the spoon so it puffs.
Fry for about 30 seconds on each side without browning and drain on paper.
Serve immediately while hot and puffed.
